A practical **European owner/operator-selection longlist** for design-forward or distinctive-character positioning usually spans three groups: soft collections, fully programmed lifestyle brands, and lean urban concepts.

## 1. Soft brands and collections

Usually the first consideration when an owner wants to **retain the hotel’s name, architecture and individual identity** while gaining distribution, loyalty and operating support.

- **Marriott:** Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, The Luxury Collection and Design Hotels  
- **Hilton:** Curio Collection and Tapestry Collection  
- **Accor:** MGallery Collection, Handwritten Collection and, at luxury level, Emblems Collection  
- **IHG:** Vignette Collection  
- **Hyatt:** The Unbound Collection, JdV by Hyatt and Destination by Hyatt  
- **Radisson:** Radisson Collection and Radisson Individuals  
- **Other European options:** Leonardo Limited Edition and, depending on positioning, NH Collection  

These brands differ in how prescriptive they are: Design Hotels is closer to a selective affiliation model, while collections such as Autograph, Curio, MGallery and Vignette typically involve a fuller brand/franchise relationship. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands?utm_source=openai))

## 2. Full-service lifestyle and boutique brands

Appropriate where the owner wants a **stronger guest-experience concept**, active public spaces, destination F&B and clear design storytelling.

- **Ennismore/Accor:** 25hours Hotels, The Hoxton, Mama Shelter, Mondrian, SO/, Hyde and SLS  
- **IHG:** Hotel Indigo, Kimpton and Ruby  
- **Hyatt:** Andaz, Thompson Hotels, The Standard, StandardX and Me and All Hotels  
- **Marriott:** EDITION, W Hotels and Renaissance; Autograph may also compete here  
- **Hilton:** Canopy by Hilton; selected Curio properties also compete directly with lifestyle brands  
- **Radisson/PPHE:** art’otel and Radisson RED  
- **Minor Hotels:** nhow  
- **Leonardo:** NYX Hotels  

Hotel Indigo, for example, is built around neighbourhood-specific design, while art’otel uses signature artists and contemporary art as the property concept. Me and All is positioned as a flexible, conversion-friendly European lifestyle brand. ([ennismore.com](https://ennismore.com/develop-with-us/lifestyle-collective/?utm_source=openai))

## 3. Lean, select-service and affordable-design concepts

Commonly examined for urban projects where owners want **high design impact with smaller rooms, simplified service and efficient staffing**.

- **Marriott:** Moxy, Aloft and citizenM  
- **IHG:** Ruby and, in certain markets, Holiday Inn – the niu  
- **Accor/Ennismore:** TRIBE, Mama Shelter and JO&JOE  
- **Radisson:** Prize by Radisson and Radisson RED  
- **European specialists:** Motel One, The Cloud One Hotels and Me and All Hotels  
- **Leonardo:** NYX Hotels  

CitizenM joined Marriott in July 2025, while Ruby became part of IHG’s brand portfolio in 2025, so both increasingly enter comparisons alongside the major-chain lifestyle platforms. ([marriott.com](https://www.marriott.com/brands/citizenm/faqs.mi?utm_source=openai))

## 4. Lifestyle extended-stay and hybrid hospitality

For projects with longer stays, larger units or mixed hotel/residential demand:

- **Locke**
- **Zoku**
- **Cove by Locke**
- **Hyatt House or Element**, if lifestyle character is secondary to an established extended-stay system
- Selected **citizenM**, **The Social Hub** or coliving-style concepts, depending on planning and operating requirements

Locke is especially associated with locally led design, kitchens, social spaces, coworking and destination F&B, while Zoku positions itself around living-and-working hospitality. ([lockeliving.com](https://www.lockeliving.com/en/this-is-your-place?utm_source=openai))

## Most typical shortlist by project type

| Asset objective | Brands most likely to be examined |
|---|---|
| Historic or individually designed upscale conversion | Autograph, Curio, MGallery, Vignette, Unbound, Radisson Collection |
| Smaller upscale independent conversion | Tribute, Tapestry, Handwritten, JdV, Radisson Individuals |
| Design-led urban full-service hotel | Hotel Indigo, Canopy, 25hours, Hoxton, Me and All, NYX, Radisson RED |
| Luxury lifestyle or trophy development | EDITION, W, Kimpton, Andaz, Thompson, The Standard, Mondrian, SO/, SLS |
| Efficient urban lifestyle hotel | Moxy, citizenM, Ruby, Motel One, The Cloud One, Prize by Radisson, TRIBE |
| Art-led statement property | Design Hotels, art’otel, Autograph, MGallery, nhow |
| Lifestyle aparthotel or longer-stay product | Locke, Zoku, Cove by Locke |

The right consideration set ultimately depends on **ADR and segment, room count, conversion versus new build, F&B potential, local customer base, franchise versus management or lease preference, and how much creative control the owner wishes to retain**. For a highly individual existing building, soft collections normally deserve priority; for a new-build urban scheme, harder lifestyle brands can provide a clearer concept but generally impose more extensive design and operating requirements.
